# International Gem Society

> The International Gem Society (IGS) provides comprehensive gemstone education, professional certification courses, and industry resources for aspiring and practicing gemologists worldwide.

IGS offers a complete ecosystem for gemstone learning, from beginner courses for kids to professional gemologist certifications. The organization maintains extensive reference libraries, pricing guides, and a directory of vetted suppliers to support both education and professional practice in the gem and jewelry industry.

## Key Topics

- Gemology education
- Gem identification
- Diamond certification
- Gemstone properties
- Professional gemologist certification
- Diamond specialist certification
- Mineralogy
- Gem pricing and valuation
- Lapidary and jewelry making
- Gemstone encyclopedia
- 4Cs diamond grading
- Birthstones
- Synthetic gemstones
- Crystallography
- Gem appraisal

## Professional Certification Courses

- [Professional Gemologist Certification Course](https://www.gemsociety.org/course/professional-gemologist): Professional gemologist certification course with gemstone science and appraisal
- [Diamond Specialist Certification Course](https://www.gemsociety.org/course/diamond-specialist): Diamond specialist certification course covering properties, grading, and synthetics
- [Mineralogy Certification Course](https://www.gemsociety.org/course/mineralogy-certification): Mineralogy certification course on classification, crystallography, and testing
- [Gem Junior Course](https://www.gemsociety.org/course/gem-junior-course): Beginner gemology course for kids and teens with STEM earth science concepts

## Learning Resources & Course Materials

- [Learning Center](https://www.gemsociety.org/reference-library): Comprehensive library of gemstone reference charts, guides, and lapidary information
- [Course Materials: Gemology](https://www.gemsociety.org/gemology): Gemology course materials covering identification, properties, and synthetic treatments
- [Course Materials: Mineralogy](https://www.gemsociety.org/mineralogy): Mineralogy course materials on classification, crystallography, and mineral testing
- [Course Materials: Jewelry and Lapidary](https://www.gemsociety.org/jewelry-lapidary): Course materials on jewelry making, lapidary, faceting, and metalsmithing techniques

## Gemstone Reference & Guides

- [Gemstone Encyclopedia](https://www.gemsociety.org/gemstone-encyclopedia): Comprehensive gemstone encyclopedia with precious and semi-precious stone reference
- [Gem Price Guide](https://www.gemsociety.org/article/gem-pricing-guide-sample): IGS gem pricing guide for valuation of popular and collectible gemstones
- [Diamond Advice](https://www.gemsociety.org/diamond-advice): Diamond buying guide covering 4Cs, certification, lab-grown, and alternatives
- [Birthstone Chart](https://www.gemsociety.org/article/birthstone-chart): Modern and traditional birthstone chart with properties and monthly jewelry galleries

## Community & Industry Resources

- [International Gem Society Home](https://www.gemsociety.org): IGS homepage offering gemstone education, courses, and community for all levels
- [Membership](https://www.gemsociety.org/membership): IGS membership program with benefits for gemstone education and industry resources
- [Wholesale Gem and Jewelry Business Directory](https://www.gemsociety.org/recommended-suppliers): Directory of IGS member gem and jewelry suppliers, vendors, and service providers
